items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Lily, Alan Littlejohn and myself arrived with Lew Hooper in his car... with the drums, bass and Alan's horn.

ctx.x: The next day I played the 100 club and Nottingham the 29th. Replaced Buck with the John Chilton Swing Kings at a place called 'Dog and Fox' in Wimbledon, the 30th. Here was another surprise for me when I learned that John Chilton was a musician and a trumpet player to boot. When I did my first tour in England, John was collaborating with Jim Godbolt in the booking agency business. We had quite a few get togethers, but he never spoke about being a trumpet man or even a musician. And no one else ever mentioned it…

The only trouble I experienced during the tour and which was embarrassing for the orchestra and myself was the night we played in Blackpool, the 25th of May at the Casino Ballroom, which was located in an amusement park. Lily, Alan Littlejohn and myself arrived with Lew Hooper in his car. The rest of the gang had left London in a rented van as the English call a small bus, with the drums, bass and Alan's horn. After a couple of hours of waiting for the others to arrive, and when they were not there at a certain…

Eventually a 'phone call came from somewhere, and it was one of the musicians in the van calling to say that they were having trouble with the motor and did not know when they would arrive. Everybody that was connected with the ballroom started to do what they could to try to find some local musicians to fill in until the boys in the band arrived. And we were fortunate enough to find a pianist, bass and drummer. I had my flugel horn and trumpet. Lew had his tenor, so I let Alan use the flugel horn and we started…
